name: Streaming Randomness Invalidates Criminal Smart Contracts 09F0050159
text: Randomness invalidates criminal smart contracts presents the following source proposition: Smart contracts are also used for illegal activities such as money laundering and ransomware. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Redemption contracts, the traditional price commitment device for privately issued money, lack credibility, whereas pre programmed smart contracts deliver an enforceable and secure quantity commitment instead.
